newsitem.title: USA: Niagara Mohawk sees 3-4 day outage at plant.
newsitem.headline: Niagara Mohawk sees 3-4 day outage at plant.

text.p: Niagara Mohawk Power Corp (NIMO) said a repair outage of its 610 megawatt (MW) Nine Mile Point 1 nuclear power unit in upstate New York will last into early next week.
"We are taking Nine Mile Point 1 off line. We expect to be off line three to four days to repair a leak in the plant's drywell," said a NIMO spokesman.
This confirmed an earlier report from the Nuclear Regulatory Commission that NIMO planned to shut the unit, in Scriba, N.Y., later today.
Earlier this week, engineers detected leakage inside the the drywell and decided the plant needed to be shut to correct the problem, according to the spokesman.
The drywell collects drainage inside the primary containment area, where the unit's reactor is located.
The nearby 1,137 MW Nine Mile Point unit 2, which will not be affected by unit 1's shutdown, was operating at full output, the spokesman said.
NIMO operates both Nine Mile Point units. The company wholly owns unit 1 and is majority stakeholder in unit 2.
